description: Foundation: relocate the untracked notebook source into the worktree repo root, remove the committed Coming Soon page, and author the Jekyll build scaffold (_config.yml, Gemfile, package.json) and the .gitignore additions so the tree is a buildable Jekyll project root. Everything downstream depends on this. Independent of FEAT-002's rendering only insofar as it must come first — it is a hard prerequisite.
steps: From the main tree, copy the UNTRACKED source into the worktree ROOT (NOT the benmanoj.com/ subfolder) using the design §5.0 commands: /Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/benmanoj.com/index.html -> $WT/index.html; style.css -> $WT/style.css; create $WT/fonts $WT/images $WT/papers $WT/writing $WT/about $WT/public/crayonia; copy fonts/Crayonia.ttf, images/bowl.png, papers/index.html, writing/index.html, about/index.html into their $WT equivalents; copy /Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/public/crayonia/1001fonts-crayonia-eula.txt into $WT/public/crayonia/. Do NOT copy .DS_Store or Unknown.png. ($WT = /Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/.worktrees/publish-workflow)
Remove the committed Coming Soon page: git -C $WT rm benmanoj.com/index.html benmanoj.com/README.md (these are real tracked paths).

Append the Jekyll/Bundler ignore block to the existing $WT/.gitignore (do NOT rewrite the stock Node template): a comment, then .jekyll-cache/, .sass-cache/, .bundle/, vendor/, then a two-line prose comment that _site/ is intentionally NOT ignored on the primary path (CI commits it) and IS added under Alternative B.

Write $WT/_config.yml per design §9: title 'Benjamin Manoj', url https://www.benmanoj.com, markdown: kramdown with kramdown.input: GFM, the papers collection (output: true, permalink: /papers/:name/), a defaults block giving type papers layout: paper (NO title_tag default), and the exclude list (Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, vercel.json, package.json, README.md, LICENSE, PUBLISHING.md, node_modules, public, api, .agents, .worktrees, .github).
Write $WT/Gemfile per §10: source rubygems.org, gem 'jekyll', '~> 4.3', gem 'webrick', '~> 1.8'. Do NOT hand-write Gemfile.lock (CI/Ruby 3.3 owns it).
Write $WT/package.json per §13.3: name benmanoj-oauth, private true, type commonjs, engines.node '>=18'.
acceptance_criteria: git -C $WT status --short shows benmanoj.com/index.html and benmanoj.com/README.md staged for deletion.
grep in $WT/.gitignore finds .jekyll-cache/, .sass-cache/, .bundle/, vendor/ once each, and the original node_modules/ entry is still present.
_config.yml parses as YAML and contains collections.papers with permalink /papers/:name/ and 'api' in exclude.
Gemfile pins jekyll ~> 4.3 and webrick ~> 1.8; package.json has type commonjs and engines.node >=18.
verification: ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file("/Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/.worktrees/publish-workflow/_config.yml")' exits 0 (local Ruby 2.6 can parse YAML).

ruby -rjson -e 'p=JSON.parse(File.read("/Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/.worktrees/publish-workflow/package.json")); abort unless p["type"]=="commonjs" && p["engines"]["node"]' exits 0 (node was NOT on PATH during exploration).
git -C /Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/.worktrees/publish-workflow status --short shows the expected deletions and new untracked files.
findings: FEAT-001 done on branch publish-workflow. SOURCE NOW AT WORKTREE ROOT: index.html (notebook home, raw HTML — NO front matter yet; FEAT-002 must add `layout: notebook` + inline body and extract head/filter/hole into _layouts/_includes per design §6), style.css (verbatim crown-jewel; FEAT-002 appends additive .paper-body block per §7.3, do NOT modify existing selectors), fonts/Crayonia.ttf, images/bowl.png (legit 1.92MB), papers/index.html + writing/index.html + about/index.html (raw HTML references for FEAT-002 transform; papers index body is replaced by auto-list, writing/about bodies preserved verbatim), public/crayonia/1001fonts-crayonia-eula.txt (reference only; public/ excluded from build). Did NOT copy .DS_Store or Unknown.png. STILL TO CREATE (later FEATs): _layouts/{notebook,page,paper}.html, _includes/{pencil-filter,hole,header}.html, _papers/2024-01-01-example-paper.md (seed; needs REQUIRED unquoted date: YYYY-MM-DD front matter so %Y/sort work), admin/{index.html,config.yml}, api/{auth.js,callback.js}, vercel.json, .github/workflows/build.yml, PUBLISHING.md. CONFIG AUTHORED: _config.yml (kramdown GFM; collections.papers output:true permalink /papers/:name/; defaults type papers -> layout:paper, NO title_tag default; exclude includes api/public/.agents/.worktrees/.github etc.), Gemfile (jekyll ~>4.3, webrick ~>1.8 — do NOT hand-write Gemfile.lock, CI/Ruby 3.3 owns it), package.json (benmanoj-oauth, private, type commonjs, engines.node >=18). GITIGNORE: appended Jekyll/Bundler block (.jekyll-cache/ .sass-cache/ .bundle/ vendor/) + prose note that _site/ is intentionally NOT ignored on primary path (CI commits it); stock Node template left intact. GIT: benmanoj.com/index.html + benmanoj.com/README.md git-rm'd (staged deletions); new files staged by name. ENV: local Ruby 2.6.10 only, no version manager/Homebrew/Docker, node not on PATH — so NO jekyll build ran locally; verification was static (ruby -ryaml parsed _config.yml OK; ruby -rjson confirmed package.json type=commonjs & engines.node; git status shows expected deletions+untracked). Real Jekyll 4.3 build is owned by GitHub Actions (Ruby 3.3). No _site/, vendor/, or Gemfile.lock created or committed.
